welcome.title: Welcome
welcome.subtitle: Let's set up your network streamer together. Just a few steps: network, music sources, and you're ready to listen.

input.title: How do you use the device?
input.subtitle: You can change this any time in Settings.

mode.title: How will you use this device?
mode.subtitle: You can change this any time in Settings.
mode.guiSub: Use the touchscreen interface on this device
mode.headlessSub: No screen — control from your phone or browser
mode.headlessWarning: The screen will turn off. You will control this device from the companion app, from http://hifiplayer.local, and from the Lyrion web interface (:9000). Continue?
mode.waitSubtitle: This device is now headless. Connect to the setup hotspot or open http://hifiplayer.local to finish.

network.title: Network connection
network.subtitle: The network will be configured automatically (DHCP).
network.wiredFailed: Wired connection failed. Make sure the cable is plugged in.

wifi.title: Wi-Fi networks
wifi.connectFailed: Wi-Fi connection failed. Check the password.

audio.title: Audio output
audio.subtitle: Choose the DAC or sound card to use for playback.

sources.title: Configure from your phone
sources.subtitle: Scan the QR with your phone to open the full box setup and complete configuration from your smartphone.
sources.scanHint: Scan the QR code with your phone camera

lyrion.title: Music server ready
lyrion.subtitle: Lyrion Music Server is running. From here you can access the advanced library settings from your computer, whenever you like.
lyrion.label: Lyrion Music Server
lyrion.webHint: Full web interface of the server
lyrion.notInstalledHint: Lyrion Music Server is not installed on this device. Install it now to manage your music library.
lyrion.installFailed: Lyrion installation failed. Check your connection and try again.
lyrion.modeHint: Does this device run the music server, or do you already have one on your network?
lyrion.externalHint: Pick the server found on your network, or type its address.
lyrion.noneFound: No Lyrion server found on the network yet.
lyrion.externalApplied: This device now uses that server.
lyrion.externalFailed: Could not switch to that server. Check the address and try again.

player.connectError: Unable to connect to the server. Check the URL in Settings.

discover.mixStarted: Mix started: the queue keeps itself topped up.
discover.mixError: Couldn't start the mix (Random Mix plugin not enabled?).
discover.dstmOn: On ({provider}): music continues when the queue ends.
discover.dstmOff: Off: playback stops at the end of the queue.
discover.dstmSetupHint: Pick a provider once in Lyrion → Settings → Don't Stop The Music, then the toggle will appear here.
discover.similarHint: Artists with ▶ are in your library: tap to play them.
discover.hint: Play a track to see similar artists and a biography. Suggestions use the Lyrion "MusicArtistInfo" and "Don't Stop The Music" plugins.

player.noPlayerHint: The server may not have responded yet. Try connecting again.
player.lyricsNone: No lyrics found for this track.
player.saveError: Couldn't save the playlist. Check that a playlist folder is configured in Lyrion.

cd.ripDone: Rip complete! The album is in your library.
cd.ripError: Rip failed. Check the disc and try again.
cd.noDestination: No writable destination: adopt an internal disk from Settings → Music sources.

playback.help: Playback options applied to the active player: track transitions (crossfade/gapless) and volume normalisation (ReplayGain).
playback.noPlayer: No active player found. Start playback or check the Lyrion connection.

dsp.help: Optional digital signal processing: a parametric equalizer and headphone crossfeed applied to all playback.
dsp.warning: Turning DSP on disables bit-perfect playback (audio is resampled and DSD/DoP pass-through is bypassed). Leave it off for critical listening with an external DAC.
dsp.unavailable: DSP engine not installed on this device yet. It is set up automatically on the next system update (requires an internet connection).
dsp.noBands: No EQ bands. Add one to boost or cut a frequency.
dsp.roomCorrectionPresent: Filter loaded: {filename}. Upload a new one any time below, or run the guided measurement.
dsp.roomCorrectionMissing: No filter loaded yet. Upload a WAV/TXT convolution filter (REW/rePhase) below, or run the guided measurement.

roomcorr.title: Guided room correction
roomcorr.intro: The appliance plays a test sweep, records it with a USB measurement microphone and automatically generates the correction filter for this room.
roomcorr.req1: Connect a USB measurement microphone (e.g. miniDSP UMIK-1).
roomcorr.req2: Place the microphone at the listening position, at ear height.
roomcorr.req3: Set a normal listening volume and keep the room quiet during the measurement.
roomcorr.position: When you're ready, start: you'll hear a sweep of about 10 seconds.
roomcorr.noMic: No USB microphone detected. Connect one and reopen the wizard.
roomcorr.keepQuiet: Keep the room quiet until the measurement is done.
roomcorr.error: Measurement failed. Check the microphone and volume, then try again.

multiroom.help: Group other players on your network with this device so they play the same music in sync (native Lyrion sync).
multiroom.noOthers: No other players found on the network. Multiroom needs at least one more player (e.g. another Osmium device or a squeezelite player).
multiroom.failed: Could not change the multiroom group.

role.title: Music server
role.help: This device can run its own Lyrion Music Server, or use one that is already running on your network. Two devices can only be grouped when they point at the same server.
role.hostRequired: Enter the IP address of the device to follow.
role.failed: Could not update the Lyrion server.
role.noneFound: No Lyrion server found automatically. Enter the IP address by hand below.

name.title: This player's name
name.help: Every Osmium Sound device is named "OsmiumSound" by default — group two of them and you can't tell them apart. Give it a unique name (e.g. "LivingRoom", no spaces).
name.failed: Could not update the player name.

server.channelWarning: Nightly and development builds are pre-release: expect the occasional bug. You can switch back to Release at any time.

webRemote.help: Pair the Osmium Sound Companion app (Android) with this device by scanning the QR code (it also carries a one-time pairing token). To control this device from a plain browser instead, open the address shown below the code.
webRemote.noIp: No network address available yet. Connect the device to the network (Ethernet or Wi-Fi) to get a control link.
webRemote.revokeAllHelp: If you've lost a phone that was paired, or think a pairing code may have been copied, revoke all pairings — phones will need to be paired again by scanning a new QR code.
webRemote.revokeAllConfirm: Revoke all paired phones? They will need to be paired again.

webRemoteIos.help: On iPhone/iPad, use LyrPlay — a free app already on the App Store for controlling Lyrion/Squeezebox: native FLAC/Opus decoding, real background playback, lock-screen controls, CarPlay and Siri. Scan the QR to download it. Note: DSP, updates, reboot and multiroom role stay kiosk-only.
webRemoteIos.scanHint: Scan to open LyrPlay on the App Store
webRemoteIos.disclaimer: LyrPlay is a third-party app, not developed by or affiliated with this project. Listed only as a compatible Lyrion/Squeezebox client.

backup.help: Export or restore this device's configuration (DAC, DSP/EQ, music sources, mouse pointer, update channel) from a browser on your phone or PC. Open the address below or scan the QR code, then use "Download backup" or "Restore from file".

alarm.help: Schedule alarms on the active player. At the set time the player wakes up and starts playing.

ssh.help: Enable or disable the SSH server for remote terminal access to the device.
ssh.warning: SSH is disabled by default. Turn it on only if you know what you are doing — the login below has full administrator rights on the appliance.
ssh.unavailable: SSH service is not installed on this device.
ssh.installHint: SSH is not installed yet: enabling it will install and start it automatically (requires an internet connection).
ssh.noLogin: No SSH login has been created on this device yet.
ssh.sudoWarning: This login has full administrator rights (sudo). SSH is for advanced users — use at your own risk.
ssh.loginFailed: Could not update the SSH login.

pointer.help: Show the mouse pointer on screen. Useful if you use the device with a mouse instead of the touchscreen. The pointer is hidden by default.
pointer.unavailable: Pointer control is not available on this device.

displayMode.help: Choose whether this device runs with the on-screen touchscreen interface or headless (no screen), controlled remotely from the Android companion app, the Lyrion web interface (port 9000) or the music sources page (port 8080).
displayMode.headlessWarning: The screen will turn off immediately. You will then control this device only from the companion app, http://hifiplayer.local:9000 (Lyrion) and :8080 (sources). To bring the interface back, use the companion app → Settings → Display mode.
displayMode.failed: Could not change the display mode.

lyrion.urlHelp: Enter the address of your Lyrion Media Server (e.g. http://192.168.1.100:9000)
lyrion.rescanHelp: Re-check the music folders for new or changed tracks.

sources.help: Add your music folders: USB sticks/drives (auto-mounted), network (SMB) or local folders. Press "Apply & rescan" when done.

audio.help: Choose the playback device (DAC). The selection is saved and kept across reboots. DSD playback is bit-perfect (DoP).

network.dhcpNotice: The network is configured automatically via DHCP. Plug in the Ethernet cable or set up Wi-Fi to get an IP address.

updates.channelWarning: Development channel: you will receive prerelease, potentially unstable builds. Switch back to Production when you finish testing.
updates.orderNote: Updates are applied by the player itself, in order: system, operating system (with a reboot if needed) and interface. The update carries on even if this screen closes.
updates.lyrionRestartNote: The music server will be restarted when finished.

msg.updateOsError: Error during the operating system update

overlay.keepPowered: Do not power off the device during the update.

factory.help: Erase all settings and return the device to its initial state (Wi-Fi networks, music sources, DSP/room correction, Bluetooth, companion pairing and the web-admin account are all cleared). The device restarts into the setup wizard.
factory.confirm: This erases ALL settings and the web-admin account, then restarts into the setup wizard. This cannot be undone. Continue?
factory.running: Factory reset started — the device will restart…
factory.failed: Could not start the factory reset.

webuiReset.confirm: This clears the web admin account so it can be recreated on the next web login. Other settings are unaffected. Continue?
webuiReset.failed: Could not reset the web interface credentials.
